reason: README offers torch.hub pretrained DETR R50 inference that runs on CPU with a ~160MB checkpoint and no credentials.
goal: Get the repo's DETR R50 pretrained model loading via torch.hub (the repo at /work/detr may be used as a local hub source) and run CPU inference on an image such as a COCO photo of two cats on a couch with remotes. The model must output 100 queries with logits of shape (1,100,92) and boxes, and post-processing must yield confident detections of cats and remotes.
check: The hidden test loads the pretrained detr_resnet50 on a COCO image and verifies output shapes and that cats and a remote are detected with score above 0.9.
